name: healing word
lore:
### The Litany of Restoration: *Healing Word*

*Healing Word* is the swiftest of mercies. To shape the Weave thus is to pluck a single, taut silver thread; it requires no grand gesture, only the precise vibration of a soul-felt syllable. As the word leaves the lips, it manifests as a faint, amber pulse—a shimmer of heat-haze that races across the battlefield like a guided whisper.

The recipient feels a sudden, cooling rush, as if a draft of spring water flowed directly into the marrow. Lacerations seal and bruised ribs knit together in a singular, rhythmic heartbeat. Unlike the laborious chants of greater restoration, this is magic of the moment—sharp, crystalline, and effortless.

Scholars trace its origin to the *Canticle of the Silent Monk*. Legend speaks of Brother Orym, who, bound by a lifelong vow of silence, saw his companion fall beneath a giant’s mace. Breaking his fast of speech, Orym uttered a solitary name with such profound love that the magic of the spheres responded instantly. It remains a testament that in the cacophony of war, a single, well-placed truth can stave off the grave.
